As Apple (AAPL) Shares Declined, Clough Capital Partners LP Has Decreased Position; As Mckesson (MCK) Market Valuation Declined, Shareholder Roystone Capital Management LP Lowered Position
May 16, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Charles Clough decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 53.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Clough Capital Partners LP sold 187,300 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund run by Charles Clough held 163,910 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $27.74M, down from 351,210 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clough Capital Partners LP who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $923.95B market cap company. The stock increased 0.83% or $1.54 during the last trading session, reaching $187.98. About 10.59 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
